primary.title: HDFC Life Insurance Company Q1 results: Profit rises 12% YoY to ₹611 crore; VNB up 9%
primary.summary: HDFC Life Insurance Company reported a 12% YoY rise in its standalone profit to ₹611.42 crore for Q1FY27. Value of new business (VNB) for the quarter rose by 9% YoY to ₹879 crore.
